packet: V2-QUAL-ORACLE-DIRECT (V1 acceptance #6 exact narrow Over correctness, #9 unsupported fallback safe)
frozen_before_any_run: V3: frozen before any V3 run (V1 ran once: oracle-01; V2 ran once: oracle-02)

fixture.negative_case_marks: MARK neg-<kind> BEGIN|END around every negative case, QUIET_MS apart
fixture.repeat_case: 8x8 composite from the 4x4 RepeatNormal source: the repeat takes effect, so EXA keeps it

expected_cases.persistent_formula: 6 sizes x 6 alphas x 6 sources x 6 destinations + offset + clip

predicates.correctness: every phase: fail == 0 and maxd == 0 (exact RGB, no tolerance) and the oracle prints RESULT PASS
predicates.case_counts: each PHASE_RESULT cases equals expected_cases for that phase
predicates.direct_attribution: GATEA_EVENT event=5 inside the persistent window (V2 window rule) == persistent cases; requires the event stream complete
predicates.negative_no_direct: event=5 inside the negative phase window == 0; per-case counts (neg-<kind> windows) are reported so a breach names the case
predicates.fresh_direct: reported, not required (fresh pairs churn registration; admission may legally fall to staging)
predicates.lifecycle: close summary: c12==c13, c14==c15, c16==c17, c18==c19==c20==0, c21..c24==0, c27==1, generationFatal==0, firstFailed==0
predicates.no_fatal: zero Fatal signal / GATEA_FATAL_HALT / tombstone lines naming X or the Activity
predicates.x_survives: X alive until terminate; Activity pid constant through the close
predicates.environment: X3 TracerPid 0; screen Awake and unlocked before and after; Stable :1 before == after
predicates.window: event=5 counted when its logcat stamp t_s satisfies BEGIN - 1 ms < t_s <= END (stamps are truncated to the ms)
predicates.construction: validity: every gap between phase windows >= quiet_gap_min_s and one BEGIN/END pair per negative case - otherwise the V2 fixture did not run (INVALID)
predicates.event5_stream_complete: validity: all GATEA_EVENT seq 0..nextSequence-1 present, OR (summary generationFatal == 0 and firstFailed == 0 and no fatal line) and count(event=5 lines from X/Activity) == c0

verdict.FAIL_CORRECTNESS: any exact-RGB mismatch, a composite error, or a lifecycle / fatal predicate false; also any event=5 inside the negative window (an op outside the Over a8r8g8b8->x8r8g8b8 slice took a direct GPU lease: #9 breached)
verdict.FAIL_ATTRIBUTION: correct pixels, but fewer persistent cases took the direct path than cases run - the direct path is not proven for all of them
verdict.INVALID: environment or capture predicate false, the event=5 stream not proven complete, or case counts wrong (the fixture did not run as frozen); also any correctness or attribution check that could not be evaluated

supersedes.V3_change: attribution needs every event=5 line, not every line: valid when all events are complete OR (no fatal and event=5 lines == c0 DIRECT_PUBLISH). Source proof: LEASE_GPU_OWNED (InitOutput.c:3419) and DIRECT_PUBLISH (:3484) have one trace site each in one function with only halting paths between them; c0 is a shared-memory counter logd cannot drop. Observed on oracle-01 / oracle-02 / b3-attr-01: event=5 lines == c0 == c6 (1335 / 1334 / 6790). Not a tolerance: an equality that proves the attributed quantity complete.
